$comment: Canonical map of every surface this demo contributes to a Horizon host: SDK zone extensions, full-page routes, and dynamic columns. Single source of truth shared by the app (src/integration/zones.ts drives registration from it) and the netsapiens-horizon-testing Playwright suite (asserts each testId mounts). testId scheme: extensions 'sdk-demo-ext-<id minus demo- prefix>', routes 'sdk-demo-page-<slug>', columns 'sdk-demo-col-<field>'. Each injected extension is also tagged with data-zone. The testId + data-zone ride on each widget's OWN root element (no wrapper element), so the marker is a real, visible box — assert VISIBILITY (toBeVisible). A component that renders null (an inactive zone) has no marker, which is the accurate signal. 'version' mirrors package.json version and is the value to register the app under: the remote entry URL is stable, so the registered version is the only thing that tells Horizon to re-verify the bytes at that URL. It must match package.json — the deploy workflow fails the build if it drifts.
$comment_requiredScopes: Where a route or column declares `requiredScopes`, it is recorded here so the Playwright suite knows which signed-in scope can assert that surface — but the manifest is NOT what registers it. The enforcing value is an inline string literal at the registerRoute/registerDynamicColumn call site in App.tsx, because the platform analyser extracts an app's declared surface by reading string literals out of submitted source and cannot follow a constant or a loop. The duplication is deliberate; keep the two in step.
